row.name: Android-Toolbox
row.description: Android-Toolbox is a desktop app which enables the user to access android device features which are not accessible directly from the mobile device. One of Android-Toolbox's special features is to transfer files at the highest speed using ADB push and pull bypassing a lot of Android API overheads.
